import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    x = float(x)
    y = float(y)
    n = int(n)
    
    target = x / y
    p = 0
    s = 1
    best = 1e40
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        val = target * i
        candidates = [math.floor(val), math.ceil(val)]
        
        for c in candidates:
            err = abs(target - c / i)
            if err < best:
                best = err
                p = c
                s = i
    
    print(f"{p}/{s}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
